principles: One coherent experiment-arm system (reuse B-ab8d's resolveExperimentArm; do not add a second resolver/env/event).
Measurement stays lossless via the experience_pack_surfaced event, independent of what the host-visible JSON carries.
Non-control paths (treatment, no-experiment) must be byte-identical no-ops.
drivers: Control-arm isolation VALIDITY for the experience-ablation experiment: a control-arm host must not be able to read stored memory through any live host-visible surface.
Minimize blast radius on B-ab8d's already-merged infrastructure.

options.name: A: thin isolation layer on B-ab8d
pros: Keeps B-ab8d's measurement-shape contract + passing smokes
cons: Adds a redaction call at each JSON surface (must not miss one)

options.name: B: rewrite B-ab8d to not keep the JSON pack
cons: Large blast radius on already-merged B-ab8d

options.name: C: block every serialized command on control
cons: Blocks non-memory fields of those commands

chosen: A: thin isolation layer on B-ab8d
rationale: A is the smallest change that fully closes the leak while preserving B-ab8d's contracts: it reuses B-ab8d's resolver/event, keeps the JSON pack KEY (so B-ab8d's measurement shape + its smokes are unchanged) while emptying its CONTENT on control, and leaves treatment/no-experiment byte-identical. B breaks B-ab8d's measurement contract; C is over-broad and harms non-control usage.

preMortem.scenario: Stale-file merge silently reverts an unrelated main change
preMortem.trigger: Bringing a touched file from an older branch instead of re-deriving from the current main base
preMortem.consequence: An unrelated feature regresses (this happened once: command-policy.ts quantum_claim policies were deleted)
preMortem.mitigation: Re-derive each touched file from the current main base and re-apply only the intended edits, verified by git diff showing only the intended deletions

preMortem.scenario: Redaction fails OPEN on an internal error
preMortem.trigger: A malformed pack or a resolver throw inside redactMemoryPackForControlArm
preMortem.consequence: Stored memory leaks to a control-arm host despite the isolation layer
preMortem.mitigation: Resolve the arm first (default non-control on resolver error) and FAIL CLOSED inside control (return a fresh empty pack, never the input); covered by a throwing-getter smoke case

preMortem.scenario: A future memory surface bypasses the redaction
preMortem.trigger: A new command serializes the pack without calling redactMemoryPackForControlArm
preMortem.mitigation: A hermetic e2e exercises the real handlers end-to-end and the consumer-wiring oracle requires surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack at final_response_check

preMortem.scenario: Emptying the JSON pack breaks a downstream consumer
preMortem.trigger: Some analysis reads pack CONTENT from the JSON rather than the experience_pack_surfaced event
preMortem.consequence: Measurement or a dependent tool breaks
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the pack KEY present (empty) so the shape is stable; confirm main's experience-pack-arm-switch smoke (asserts key-presence) still passes
